weaknesses.title: WAITSTABLE/WAITCHANGED are size+mtime only — same-size content rewrite may not fire
weaknesses.detail: Peer can rewrite plate with identical byte length and same-second mtime; settle/changed miss content churn. No hash/content quiet mode. Complements WAITMATCH substring traps.
weaknesses.repro: WRITE same-length payload; WAITCHANGED may timeout

weaknesses.title: MKTEMP lands under system TMP not CUBALC_STATE
weaknesses.detail: Agent isolation under STATE is broken; temps scatter in /tmp. Concurrent hosts share namespace. No MKTEMP DIR=STATE option.

weaknesses.title: WAITSTABLE vs WAITFILE vs WAITMATCH vs WAITCHANGED name swarm
weaknesses.detail: Four wait families with different predicates (exist/content/quiet/change). Agents pick wrong waiter under stress.
weaknesses.repro: WAITFILE empty TOUCH vs WAITSTABLE missing

weaknesses.title: WRITEATOMIC trailing NL omit after settle write
weaknesses.detail: host=peer and line1 without $; cat -A glues.

weaknesses.title: SINCE needs durable size/mtime plates + NUM reparse across ticks
weaknesses.detail: No atomic SNAPSHOT primitive returning both; agent WRITE two plates and NUM shuttle fragile under WRITE NL glue.

weaknesses.title: WAITCHANGED without SINCE only sees future changes after call starts
weaknesses.detail: Cannot detect change that already happened; need SINCE snapshot first. Easy agent footgun.

weaknesses.title: MKTEMP no auto-cleanup / no STATE-scoped GC
weaknesses.detail: Agents leak /tmp files; no MKTEMP CLEAN or linked lifecycle.

workarounds: Prefer WAITMATCH for known content; WAITSTABLE only for torn-write settle
HASHFILE after stable for content identity
Digit-check REQUIRE; clean MKTEMP paths on exit
Copy mktemp into STATE if isolation required
